Output a SQUARE 2048x2048 RGBA sprite atlas containing EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, sixteen equal cells. Exactly ONE complete subject in each cell. Cell centres at 12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% on each axis. Identical scale, camera and anchor across ALL cells. Upright figures use the SAME foot baseline and head size. Every weapon and appendage stays strictly INSIDE its own cell, with at least 10% transparent padding. Front three-quarter view toward screen right. A regal ivory skeleton king with a clearly visible antique-gold crown, heavy old-gold shoulder plates, deep muted plum cape lined moss-green, massive notched longsword held at its side. Towering commanding silhouette, empty dark eye sockets with tiny jade pinlights, no gore. Row 1: four subtle breathing idle frames with a gentle blink. Row 2: four clearly different walk-cycle frames (left stride, passing, right stride, passing). Row 3: four attack frames appropriate to its exact existing weapon: ready, windup or draw bow, strike or release, recover. Row 4: first two hit reaction frames (small recoil then recover); last two defeated/incapacitated poses (kneel then lie on side), no gore or blood. Independently draw genuine successive poses, not sixteen identical copies. No particles or large magic effects. Never crop limbs, weapon tips or the character. No pose crosses cell boundaries. Critical: do not draw flying arrows, detached projectiles, dust or ground shadows. Keep each figure under 80% of cell width and height; all sixteen poses at exactly identical character scale.
